column1: # SMOKE_WIRING.tsv — the CHECKED contract for where each examples/mindc_mind smoke runs.
#   runners  comma-joined subset of {ci, keystone, preflight}, or "none"
#              ci        executed by a step in .github/workflows/*.yml
#   class    gate   | a standalone pass/fail regression gate
#            helper | an importable module, never invoked directly
#            tool   | an analysis/measurement utility with no pass/fail verdict
#            wip    | landed but unfinished; unwired on purpose
#   note     free text; REQUIRED for any row whose runners are "none"
# examples/mindc_mind/smoke_wiring_lint.py re-derives the runners column from the
# runner scripts themselves and fails the build on any divergence, so this file
# cannot silently rot the way the prose comments it replaced did (ci.yml claimed
# fast_keystone.sh "runs the SAME set"; fast_keystone.sh claimed "CI protects
# each landed rung" — both were false).
# deferred: five `gate` rows below are UNWIRED because they are RED at this commit,
# not because they are unimportant. They are recorded here with their exact
# failing case so the gap is visible instead of implied; wiring them into CI is
# blocked on FIXING them (each note names what must change). Do not wire a red
# gate to make this list look tidy, and do not delete a red gate to make CI green.

column4: Generator + independent interpreter of the control-flow corpus imported by self_host_native_cf_smoke; not a gate — running it directly is a no-op.

Capacity program generators (giant flat lists, deep trees, many functions, giant tokens) with independently computed expectations, imported by self_host_native_cf_smoke; not a gate — running it directly is a no-op.
Oracle .so heap checks (main.mind free contract, malloc-checked .so child, self-emit) imported by self_host_native_cf_smoke; not a gate — running it directly is a no-op.
Owned project fixtures and unscoped-import refusal control imported by self_host_tc_unknown_call_smoke.
Manifest parsing and frozen artifact integrity checks imported by self_host_native_elf_smoke.
Focused legacy Rust-seeded publication path imported by self_host_loop_smoke.py; not a gate — running it directly is a no-op.
Shared self-host .so resolver imported by the smokes (resolve_so); not a gate — running it directly is a no-op.
Immutable internal compiler source capture and library/native view materialization; imported bootstrap orchestration, not product runtime or native admission.

Mini-language of self_host_native_shadow_scope_smoke (lexically scoped model interpreter, printer, seeded generator, alpha-renamer), imported by that smoke; not a gate - running it directly is a no-op.

Shared reader for testdata/stdlib_manifest.txt (seed_modules/bundled_modules/seed_blob), imported by the self-host smokes and the twin of mindc.rs::frozen_std_seed_modules; not a gate — running it directly is a no-op.

Shared harness of the W8 float smokes (self_host_native_f64_lit_smoke, self_host_native_f64_intrinsics_smoke): derives a stage1 compiler from main.mind with the frozen seed and compiles a program natively; imported by them, not a gate - running it directly is a no-op.

deferred: CI must provision exact reviewed native compiler and freshly rebuilt CPU shell hashes before wiring this captured component build gate. Explicit unit-only mode does not claim backend parity. No seed or admission change.
Analysis only (self-host construct-coverage report, says so in its docstring); prints numbers, has no pass/fail verdict, so there is nothing for a runner to gate on.

Scoped Phase-6.5 bootstrap reproducer: requires a hand-produced /tmp/oracle_pure.mlir, so in any clean environment it exits rc=2 VERDICT: BLOCKED. deferred: superseded as a gate by self_host_loop_smoke + mic3_flip_smoke; upgrade path = have it generate its own oracle via `mindc --emit-ir` (as the smokes that replaced it do), then wire it.

RED at this commit: `mindc build` cannot lower std.time — warning[type-check][E2024] `__mind_now_ns` is not registered in STD_SURFACE_INTRINSICS, so the substrate compile for std.time fails. deferred: wire once __mind_now_ns is in the Rust/MLIR intrinsic table (or the smoke is retargeted at the native-ELF self-host path that does implement it).

Bounded native profile (768 MiB arena + 1 MiB guard + 384 MiB stack): pinned seed derives from the frozen default seed, self-reproduces and runs consumer programs under RLIMIT_AS=2 GiB, and refuses arena exhaustion (incl. the fill_0..fill_4 cap boundary), stack overflow and bad layouts fail-closed. CI only: three whole self-compiles (~4 min) are too slow for fast_keystone.sh / preflight.

Bounded native allocator (W11c): derives the tree's bounded compiler natively (B2 == B3 under RLIMIT_AS=2 GiB), checks the allocator runtime blob byte-for-byte against its assembly source (testdata/native_alloc_bounded/rt/), runs the C stress harness over it, runs every native_alloc_bounded fixture natively and through MLIR under the cap (small-footprint alloc/free/realloc loops, C-runtime edge cases, deterministic out-of-memory exit 70) and the compiler's own arena reclaim code natively. CI only: three whole self-compiles (~5 min) are too slow for fast_keystone.sh / preflight.

RED at this commit against the FROZEN seed only: main.mind is fixed (nested-loop dead tails after `continue`/`break` are truncated by every id-threading walker — nb_while_carry_wnest and nb_count_stmt's while arm, not just nb_emit_while; and every `break`/`continue` writes each carried var back to its working slot — nb_loops_exit_writeback), but testdata/selfhost_loop/stage1.elf still predates both, so the 19 nested fixtures still HANG through it, the 9 exit-edge write-back fixtures hang or return a stale value, and 3 dead-tail pairs emit different code. `self_host_continue_smoke.py <compiler.elf>` with a compiler derived from current main.mind by the frozen seed passes 46/46 (40 fixtures, 3 no-hang shapes, 3 dead-tail pairs). deferred: wire into CI in the same change that advances the frozen seed (self_host_loop_smoke.py --advance); a hanging case must never be wired into CI as-is.
General control-flow corpus, independent reference interpreter, default/bounded capacity checks, diagnosed-refusal controls, and oracle heap checks; helpers are classified separately above.
Exact [i64; N]/[u8; N] inline record-field layout, value-copy/direct reads, OOB and unsupported-shape refusal.

Canonical record-field trace: manifest-bound fixtures, byte-equal to --emit-mic3 and executed via _u, built twice for determinism; fixed-array records must stay 0-byte until their inline layout is modelled.

RED at this commit: signed-cast precedence — `a + b as i8` must parse as `a + (b as i8)` (300 + (-56) = 244, >>1 = 122) but the pure-MIND emit runs to 122 while live mindc returns 250, i.e. the loose-parse bug is in the Rust reference leg. deferred: wire once the `as` binding-power disagreement between the two front-ends is resolved.

Untracked work-in-progress in the working tree (not yet committed) and currently FAIL. deferred: classify as `gate` and wire when the native-ELF string-literal leg lands; this row exists so the lint does not silently accept an unclassified new file.

RED at this commit: 1/60 three-leg divergence (SEV-1) — `esc-dquote i64->i32 DECLINED in-domain: port=0(raw=-3) leg2=1 live=1`, i.e. the pure-MIND rule port declines a case both the reference legs accept. deferred: wire once the escaped-double-quote identifier case matches live `mindc check`.

std-manifest contract: manifest<->std/ on disk and manifest<->STDLIB_MIND_SOURCES both directions, plus the seed-blob sha256 pin that makes a reseed event impossible to land quietly. Pure text analysis, so it needs no .so and is not wired into fast_keystone.sh (which builds artifacts).

RH f64-aggregate executable-path canary. Already executed by a ci.yml step; arrived from origin/main in the 9d3d5d41 merge without a manifest row, which is exactly the drift this lint exists to catch.

RI-D1 readiness gate (#313): proves `mindc build --backend native` is ready to be default FOR THE FROZEN PROFILE. It is a readiness ratchet, so a regression must block a push rather than only be noticed at flip time. RED at this commit and known to be: 3 of its 5 IN_PROFILE programs (float_as_i64, struct_return, narrow_u8_wrap) are refused `call.undefined_or_builtin` because they lower to compiler intrinsic calls (__mind_alloc/__mind_store_i64/__mind_load_i64/__mind_conv_i64) that admit_call does not admit — an OVER-rejection, fail-closed and safe, but it means the allowlist is not in bijection with this corpus (src/ir/frozen_profile.rs, admit_instrs_in). deferred: wire into CI together with the (op, operand_type)-keyed intrinsic admission that file already defers; wiring it red would block every push on a known gap.

RI-D/#10 native-float slice 1a (saturating f64 -> signed narrow, i8/i16/i32). The earlier `symbol absent (narrow rung not built)` was ENVIRONMENTAL, now proven so: the rung and this gate both landed in 5fdbfbaf, which reached this line only on the SECOND parent of the 9d3d5d41 merge, so the in-tree libmindc_mind.so (built off the first parent, before that merge) genuinely lacks the symbol while a cdylib rebuilt from the current main.mind exports it. Against that fresh .so the smoke is ALL PASS in ~5s (6 native-vs-oracle folds + 15 live-MLIR exits across i8/i16/i32), so it is wired into fast_keystone.sh, which always builds the .so it points MINDC_SO at.

The ONLY cross-implementation gate for the DTK register allocator: it checks the pure-MIND nb_dtk_* planner (which SHIPS inside the frozen stage1.elf and is consumed by nb_val_store_rax/_load_rax/_arith_rax/_prologue/_epilogue) against the Rust reference plan_module_k, field-exact, plus fail-closed count==0 on every ineligible class. It was referenced by NO runner and — because it sits one directory deeper, under testdata/ — was invisible to this very lint until the scan was widened. tests/regalloc_dtk_parity.rs is Rust-vs-Rust against hardcoded tables and does not substitute for it. Needs MIND_DTK_SKIP_RUST_REGEN=1 and MINDC_SO so a missing .so fails closed instead of skipping.

Stale-oracle provenance contract for the ~47 self-host smokes. `_selfhost_so.resolve_so()` used to hand back whatever MINDC_SO named with no freshness check, and exactly ONE of ~47 importers consulted the fallback flag, so a gitignored months-old in-tree libmindc_mind.so could certify byte-identity in every sibling gate while the self-host loop gate refused the same bytes. This asserts the resolver still REFUSES an oracle it cannot prove fresh and that no smoke opts out without being named here. Pure stdlib: no toolchain, no build, no .so needed, so it runs in CI and in preflight's --full path alike.

Current-source native stage1 filesystem syscalls and positioned I/O versus MLIR, plus bootstrap byte-neutrality: literal -1 read/write sites and the changed emitter functions compile identically under the frozen seed and stage1.
Native process, clock, directory syscalls versus MLIR with success and error paths.

Explicit-instrument standalone ELF writer diagnostic; requires a caller-selected verified native compiler. Production compiler integration and CI execution remain open; local results do not imply a CI run.

Manual source-typed MCABI001 registry gate; requires pre-enumerated cases and separately built current native driver/fresh oracle. deferred: wire CI with the generic C ABI integration once its bounded driver/oracle construction is a runner dependency; this metadata slice enables no imports or production profile.
Build current MIND compiler from the bounded seed; validate PT_NOTE bounds/refusals and literal preservation with source-hash provenance. No frozen seeds are changed.

Manual standalone MIND dynamic-layout gate with frozen fixtures, explicit hashed native compiler and fresh MLIR compiler, overlap/state controls and actual source mutations. deferred: wire CI with bounded compiler prerequisites during dynamic-runtime integration; planner success enables no production admission.

Manual exact four-argument I/O parity gate; requires a source-bound bounded native compiler and official MLIR compiler. deferred: CI artifact construction must precede this runner. Preserves raw and legacy compatibility controls; does not establish libc TLS errno or C ABI admission.

Manual scalar SysV metadata gate; frozen expected cases and explicit hash-checked current native/MLIR compiler builds. deferred: CI must first construct the source-bound current compiler; historical frozen seed alone refuses this diagnostic. Does not execute foreign calls or qualify a pin.

Manual fixed-scalar C call emission, actual ABI fixture execution and source-mutation gate. deferred: CI must construct the source-bound native/MLIR instruments and diagnostic ABI fixture. Standalone emitter does not admit production foreign calls or change a pin.

Manual MIND allocator-emitter gate; frozen runtime cases and source mutations, native/MLIR emitted-byte equality, independent assembly/C diagnostic and original static-byte control. deferred: wire CI once source-bound bounded compiler and diagnostic tools are runner dependencies. No startup, libc integration or native admission.

Manual checked-layout ELF image extension gate with frozen structural/loader/protection cases, exact native/MLIR bytes, original writer regressions and actual source mutations. deferred: wire CI with explicit bounded source-bound compiler prerequisites during dynamic-runtime integration; this component does not enable imports, startup or production admission.

Manual standalone MIND libc startup gate with frozen cases, hash-bound native/MLIR compiler and sibling allocator/image modules, actual loader execution and source mutations. deferred: CI requires those current compiler/module prerequisites; no production startup admission or qualified pin is enabled.

Manual frozen string value, constant binding, malformed match-arrow and decoder bounds gate with explicit hashed native/MLIR instruments. deferred: CI must construct the source-bound compiler before execution. Does not claim arbitrary String ownership parity or qualify a pin.

Manual explicit MIND-body borrowed-string parity, capacity boundaries, source mutations and separate C-shim sanitizer check. deferred: CI must construct hash-bound native and current CPU compiler/runtime prerequisites; no consumer qualification is implied.

Manual source-to-libc declaration binding gate; freezes exact expected bytes, builds native/MLIR diagnostics, checks source/plan forgery and signedness views, and compiles source mutants. deferred: CI needs captured-source compiler/module prerequisites. Every declaration retains callready0; no production call or pin admission.

Manual fixed libc I/O recipe gate with frozen metadata/runtime cases, exact native/MLIR bundles and images, actual libc TLS errno/file effects, existing-runtime reference and source mutations. deferred: CI requires source-bound compiler and dynamic component prerequisites; no production intrinsic-site admission or qualified pin.
